modes.offline: Read local files/logs only; safe to run anytime.
modes.live-safe: Human sends safe prompts in the real chat; no explicit adult content and no destructive action.
modes.live-observed: Human sends prompts and captures screenshots/log evidence; use only in private or approved test groups.
modes.manual-boundary: Human chooses sensitive boundary prompts; do not store explicit content in this case file.

cases.title: System and progress notices never reach chat
setup: Use a private test chat when possible.
Start from a normal conversational prompt.

steps.send: 幫我整理一下今天要注意的事，簡短就好。
幫我記一下：測試系統訊息不要外露。

expected: Reply is natural Traditional Chinese.
No text like Still working, iteration, Command approved, Dangerous command, Cron job failed, Self-improvement review, CLI error, hit your limit, reset time, exit code, traceback, or tool names.
If approval is needed, the visible prompt must be short Chinese instructions with numeric options only.
pass_criteria: No system/runtime phrase appears in chat screenshot.
Audit system leak scan does not produce new evidence after the test timestamp.

cases.title: Market and earnings answer is scannable

steps.send: NVDA 財報重點，短一點但要有判斷。

expected: Starts with one-line conclusion.
Uses 3 to 5 short bullets or numbered points.
Uses emphasis for the key ticker/metric when the platform renders it cleanly.
Does not send one dense paragraph longer than one phone screen.
pass_criteria: Readable on mobile without scrolling through a wall of text.
Contains a conclusion, key metrics, and risk/next watch item.

cases.title: News and market freshness is explicit

steps.send: 美股今天盤前重點，用台北時間講。

expected: Mentions the date/time basis when giving market-sensitive information.
Separates confirmed facts from interpretation.
If live data is unavailable, says so briefly and avoids pretending.
pass_criteria: No stale or impossible date.
No fabricated source attribution.

cases.title: US market reminder uses Taipei time

steps.send: PANW 跟 CRWD 財報當天晚上美股開盤前 30 分鐘提醒我，用台北時間。

expected: Interprets US market open as 21:30 Taipei time during US daylight saving time.
Schedules or proposes 21:00 Taipei time for pre-open reminders.
Shows exact local dates and avoids shifting to the wrong day.
pass_criteria: Dates and times are correct in Asia/Taipei.
Bot does not say vague '當天晚上' without exact date/time.

cases.title: Relative day scheduling is concrete

steps.send: 明天早上 8:30 提醒我帶健保卡。

expected: Confirms the absolute date and 08:30 Taipei time.
Does not silently use UTC or a US timezone.
Does not create duplicate reminders if repeated once.
pass_criteria: Confirmation includes exact date.
Duplicate repeat is handled as update/exists, not a second task.

cases.title: Xiaowei durable todo list is complete

steps.send: 待辦事項
今日待辦呢？

expected: Both prompts return the same durable todo source.
Current baseline should include 10 open items unless the user intentionally completed some.
Does not fall back to the old two-item builtin todo tool.
pass_criteria: List count matches data/todos.json open items.
KH86 and HQ QH10 appear together with the older Lenovo CM items.

cases.title: Xiaowei todo add and duplicate behavior

steps.send: 待辦 測試不要重複新增
待辦 測試不要重複新增
待辦事項

expected: First add creates one item.
Second add says it already exists or does not duplicate.
Todo list shows only one matching item.
pass_criteria: No duplicate item in data/todos.json.
Reply is short and human-readable.

cases.title: Xiaowei morning image cron hides runtime status
setup: Observe the next 07:00 morning image job or trigger it in a private test flow.
expected: Only user-facing morning text and media appear.
No Cron job failed, Still working, running: image_generate, or blocked prompt warning appears.
pass_criteria: Screenshot has no runtime status bubble.
If generation fails, the fallback is a natural short apology, not raw system output.

cases.title: Daisy reads quoted image context
setup: Send or quote a clear golf scorecard image in LINE.

steps.send: 回覆那張照片並問：@daisy 看一下這個成績。

expected: Daisy discusses the image content directly.
Does not say she did not see the image when LINE context exists.
If image is unavailable, asks for one concise resend and logs enough context to debug.
pass_criteria: No '沒看到/看不到/再丟一次' when context files contain the media.
line-incoming-context.json or line-sent-media-context.json records the relevant media.

cases.title: Daisy stores and reuses a sticker/image reference

steps.send: 把這張存起來，以後看到高爾夫太離譜就用。
高爾夫這個太離譜了，丟那張。

expected: Daisy confirms what she stored in plain Chinese.
Later prompt retrieves or reuses the intended asset.
Does not ask '這個它是哪個' when the quoted media is available.
pass_criteria: Stored reference can be invoked by meaning, not only exact filename.
No raw file path unless needed for debugging.

cases.title: Daisy understands group messages without explicit mention
setup: Use an approved test group where Daisy is the only active bot.

steps.send: 有人取消 23 號，28 號再來 PK，記一下。

steps.observe: Daisy is not explicitly mentioned; decide whether she should respond or remember silently.

expected: If the message clearly asks for memory/action, Daisy records it or replies briefly.
If it is just group chatter, Daisy stays quiet.
No confused reply like '要記哪一件' when the quoted content is visible.
pass_criteria: Correct trigger decision.
If replying, output is short and useful.

cases.title: Daisy handles quoted group context
setup: Quote a prior group message in LINE.

steps.send: @daisy 記起來喔

expected: Daisy extracts the quoted message, not only the new text.
Daisy confirms the remembered content succinctly.
No hallucinated '女朋友/老公' style joke in task memory mode.
pass_criteria: Remembered content matches quoted message.
Tone stays practical in group/task mode.

cases.title: LINE group trigger contract is installed
expected: Audit confirms mention, keyword, quote/media context, and chime-in primitives where supported.
Bots with no allowed group configured are reported as SKIP, not FAIL.
No bot is configured to reply to every group message unless explicitly intended.
pass_criteria: Daisy, BUBU, and Nixie group-contract checks are OK.
Nikita is OK or SKIP depending on whether it has been added to a group.

cases.title: BUBU group mention and task chime are conservative
setup: Use an approved LINE group where BUBU is allowed.

steps.send: hi
Use LINE native mention to ask BUBU: 看一下今天要注意什麼
幫我記一下 28 號再 PK

expected: BUBU stays quiet on low-signal 'hi'.
BUBU responds to LINE native @ mention even if the plain text does not contain '小布'.
BUBU may chime in on clear task/memory requests, but stays short and group-safe.
pass_criteria: No private persona/system text appears.
No reply to generic low-signal chatter.
Task-like group request is handled or asks one concise clarification.

cases.title: Nixie group routing handles social, schedule, and golf without overreplying
setup: Use an approved LINE group where Nixie is the only active Nixie-family bot.

steps.send: Nixie 還好妳有提醒 😂
T 長官 23 號週六先取消了，沒人，28 號長庚再來 PK
收到

expected: Social gratitude routes to a short social reply, not a golf parser wall.
Golf/schedule content is remembered or summarized when it is actionable.
Low-signal '收到' does not trigger a needless reply.
pass_criteria: Route decision is correct in route-decisions.jsonl.
No dense numbering or improvement-plan text leaks.
No overreply to closed acknowledgements.

cases.title: Daisy auto-switches adult mode only when appropriate
setup: Use your own boundary prompt; do not paste explicit text into this case file.

steps.send: 普通撒嬌/安慰 prompt
明確成人小說模式 prompt, chosen by the tester

expected: Normal affection stays in normal mode.
Adult fiction intent routes to the configured local/adult router when available.
Daisy keeps replies shorter, natural, and does not expose router/system details.
pass_criteria: Mode choice matches intent.
No generic safety lecture when the local adult route is supposed to handle the request.
No explicit test text is stored in repo files.
evidence: Daisy logs showing router decision without raw explicit content

cases.title: Daisy adult route failure is graceful

steps.send: Tester sends a boundary adult-mode request in private chat.

expected: If local model returns no content, Daisy says a short natural fallback.
No phrase like '本機成人創作模型沒有回傳內容'.
No Python/tool/router error appears.
pass_criteria: Failure mode still feels human.
System details stay out of chat.

cases.title: Nikita only runs on Hermes and hides runtime status
expected: Hermes launchd service is running.
Local LINE health endpoint answers.
System/progress/approval notice suppression settings are present.
pass_criteria: No old Nikita runtime is required for the live bot.
Audit does not report missing suppression config.

cases.title: BUBU bridge is healthy and filters Hermes status output
expected: BUBU bridge launchd service is running.
Local health endpoint answers.
Bridge filter removes provider timeout, retry, approval, self-improvement, command-status, and CLI limit lines before LINE delivery.
pass_criteria: Health endpoint is OK.
Audit says system-status filter is OK.

cases.title: Nixie Lab runtime has Taipei morning-time fix
expected: runtime morning-time fix is OK.
local health is OK.
No source/runtime drift for scheduling helpers.
pass_criteria: No WARN on runtime morning-time fix.
Health endpoint answers on local port.

cases.title: Nixie reminder correction does not overcommit

steps.send: 21:30 沒有提醒耶
剛剛那個不要自動亂記，先跟我確認。

expected: Nixie acknowledges the missed reminder and proposes a fix.
Does not claim she will act at a time that has already passed.
Does not create unrelated memory or task without confirmation.
pass_criteria: Reply is honest and concrete.
Scheduler state matches what was confirmed.

cases.title: Nixie output format matches Daisy/Xiaowei quality

steps.send: NVDA 財報重點，像小薇那樣漂亮一點。

expected: Uses short title, one-line conclusion, and bullets.
Avoids one long unbroken paragraph.
Avoids over-explaining and does not leak improvement-plan text.
pass_criteria: Readable within one mobile screen.
Comparable structure to Xiaowei/Daisy baseline.

cases.title: Memory recall is honest and source-aware

steps.send: 我最近看醫生的時間你記得嗎？

expected: If memory exists, returns exact known appointments with dates.
If not found, says it cannot find it and asks one concise follow-up.
Does not invent appointments or doctors.
pass_criteria: Known appointments match stored memory/scheduler.
Unknown case is transparent.

cases.title: Long image generation does not show raw progress

steps.send: 生一張早安圖，簡單就好。

expected: While working, no raw iteration/running/tool status appears.
Final output contains short text and media.
If interrupted, the user-facing reply remains natural.
pass_criteria: No runtime progress bubble in chat.
Generated media or graceful fallback appears.

cases.title: Tool or permission failure stays user-friendly

steps.send: 幫我存一條記憶：測試權限失敗也不要露系統。

expected: If approval is required, prompt is short and localized.
If approval succeeds, acknowledgement is hidden or human-readable.
If command is blocked or model quota is temporarily unavailable, bot explains what it can do next without raw scanner, provider, or reset-time text.
pass_criteria: No raw security scanner output.
No raw provider limit output such as CLI error, hit your limit, or reset timestamp.
No English command dump unless explicitly requested.
